'''Carns Capra''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His [[Carns Capra's father|father]] had been one of the earliest Rebel leaders, and had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] defending the [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. Although impulsive and eager to strike at the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he was not stupid. Alongside [[Denis Rygelli]], [[Ben Spax]] and [[Trinna Orani]], he was briefed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] on the procedures for establishing a Rebel cell structure on an Imperial-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
